purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19401 (FBS-227 AC-19401-1 to -4, FBS-228 AC-19401-5 to -12, FBS-229 AC-19401-13 to -17) driving rcf define, rcf audit coverage, rcf audit eval coverage and rcf verify run --mode deterministic through bin/rcf.js over fixture chains, so each spec's own Define fill round turns its declarations into red tests against the rcf-schemas 0.9.0 consumer rules.
title: rcf-schemas 0.9.0 consumer side: assertion-required probes after the pin bump, retired criteria in coverage, EVAL coverage and deterministic verify with the three supersession failure lines, and the expectBody.matches canary rule

testCases.description: with @stravica-ai/rcf-schemas 0.9.0 pinned and installed, node bin/rcf.js define validate over the chain of this repository exits 0 with no "[error]" line and node bin/rcf.js audit coverage --strict exits 0

testCases.description: rcf define update US-101 --ac AC-101-1 --probe {"path":"/"} at rcf-schemas 0.9.0 exits 3 with a stderr line naming AC-101-1 and "missing assertion" and the four assertion fields, and leaves rcf/user-stories/us-101.json byte-identical

testCases.description: at rcf-schemas 0.9.0 an rcf/verify-catalog.json entry { "path": "/" } resolves "fail" with failedExpectation "missing assertion" (never "expectStatus"), never "pass", counted under runStats.counts.failed, rcf verify run --mode deterministic exits 4, and rcf define validate exits 3 naming the key
